root_cause.text: The function `isofs_export_iget()` lacked an upper-bound check on the block number provided from the NFS file handle, allowing an attacker to specify any block within the backing device range (including data outside the ISO filesystem) to be read and interpreted as ISO directory metadata.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds the condition `block >= ISOFS_SB(sb)->s_nzones` along with the existing `block == 0` check. The CVE description states that a crafted file handle "can still drive the server to read any in-range block on the backing device as if it were an iso_directory_record" and that the fix "reject[s] block >= ISOFS_SB(sb)->s_nzones".
